'''December 2000 Boxboro tournament (constructed)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Boxborough, MA on 10 December 2000. [[Hayes Hunter]] won it. It is known from Michael Schiemer's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1532">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-11-boxborough-ma-12-10-00d1532/ boxborough-ma-12-10-00], DeckTech (Michael "The Rattler" Schiemer, 11 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-11-boxborough-ma-12-10-00d1532/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 10 December 2000
* '''Site:''' Boxborough, MA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Hayes Hunter]]
